'''Small scarabs''' may appear when digging each crate during the quest [[Do No Evil]]. They count towards fulfilling a [[Scabarites (Slayer assignment)|scabarites Slayer assignment]] as well as "scabarites" for [[City Quest]], but it is not susceptible to [[Keris]].
